hombre.corto: a short messy textured crop, short at the sides and back, a small uneven fringe on the forehead
hombre.coleta: long hair tied in a low ponytail that hangs down to the shoulder blades, with two loose strands framing the face
hombre.melena: loose shoulder-length slightly wavy hair parted in the middle, covering the ears
hombre.rapado: a very short buzz cut close to the scalp with a sharp hairline

mujer.bob: a short chin-length bob with a straight full fringe
mujer.suelta: very long straight loose hair falling down the back to the waist, with a side fringe
mujer.mono: hair gathered in a round high bun on top of the head with a few loose strands at the temples
mujer.trenzas: two long braids hanging over the shoulders, with a short fringe
